The '''Bellassa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]<ref name="TDM" /> and [[Tati]].<ref name="DoN" /><ref name="Email" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[March]] [[2023]] that Tati was located in the Bellassa system.<ref name="Email" />
